caption: The video depicts a top-down view of a white tabletop where two hands assemble a flat hexagonal lattice of shiny metallic spheres linked by short rods. An open box of spare spheres rests in the upper-left corner. The left hand pinches a free sphere at the lower edge of the lattice while the right hand holds a loose rod beside it. The right hand brings that rod into contact with the sphere so a new rod extends toward the lower-right, the left hand steadying the sphere while the right hand aligns the far end. Once this rod is seated, the lower portion of the lattice is shown as a closed six-membered ring. The left hand releases the sphere and drifts toward the left edge of the lattice, while the right hand holds the right-vertex sphere of the new ring to steady it.
